notes.title: Demo Update 17.09.2025 | New quest system and prisoners
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730765/35791f03c1c13bcaf3a72a06fa8d6152e9327e28.png"]

Time for another demo update!

New features:

Quest system completely rebuilt from scratch and added to the game.

Mayors added to cities. For now, they’re mostly there for quests.

Added the ability to take prisoners after battles. Players can now also be captured.

Added the ability to talk to lords directly in cities.

Item, weapon, and armor prices have been heavily reworked.

Balanced rewards players get for defeating enemies.

Adjusted unit prices and their daily wages.

Changed the experience requirements for unit upgrades.

Added a couple of convenience buttons in the co-op lobby.

Translation framework prepared. Can’t say when translations will appear, but they will :)

+ a lot of small fixes and improvements

I’m also preparing the game for the Steam demo festival, so I’d be very grateful if you could play a bit now to help find bugs.

The fewer bugs there are, the better :)

And as always - feel free to tell about bugs, it will help me a lot! 
Join Discord for more info

notes.title: Demo Update 28.07.2025 | New world map, new battle animations and easier coop
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube="Hc0Ysxb_yiw;full"][/previewyoutube]

New update for the demo version of Mainland! News: 

New world map. The size is still about the same, but I like it much more

Tournaments and a new map for the arena and tournaments. It was a bit strange that the arena was "in the desert". Now everything is as it should be.,

Simplified cooperative launch system. Now you just need to press 1 button to start the co-op automatically! In addition, you can now invite other players directly through steam. Case, the method with the code is still left as a backup,

Improvements in terms of the combat system. The AI has become smarter + a "knockback" has been added for strike animations if a blow is blocked or you hit something wrong

+ a lot of small fixes and improvements

And as always - feel free to tell about bugs, it will help me a lot! 
Join Discord for more info

notes.title: Demo Update 02.06.25 | New animations and weapon types
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730765/ca917de5c0aead91af3e2d9a6333ea68866a74c8.png

This update reworks 80% of the battle animations, as well as adding new ones for new weapons. Some points in the animations will still be corrected in the future, but I am already happy with the current result, as it is much nicer than what was before.
Bugs may well be encountered, please report if you find them 🙂
I've also laid a couple of foundations for future improvements, so the plan is that I'll continue to do combat improvements for a while longer

Features:
New weapon types. Polearms, TwoHanded Swords, Axes and Polearms. (I recommend you try it in Custom Battle)
10+ new weapons
20+ new animations for weapons
The player can now lean in during combat to better aim weapons
Improved system for attaching weapons to the fighter

Fixes:
Fixed hardlock on global map when bandits attacked a player

notes.title: Demo Update 02.04.25 | New maps
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730765/040ff292d68ee5a40e0ba11aaeb8339c77f52a2f.png

This update is partly experimental because the past map for combat was only 500 by 500 metres. The new maps are 500x500, 1000x1000 and 2000x2000 respectively. This means that the large map is 16 (!) times larger than the grass field map. In terms of performance, the difference is minimal, but we need playtests. I will most likely only use 1x1 and 2x2 km maps in the future.

Features:
1 new biome for combat and 3 new maps of different sizes.
The game's start loading screen has been added again. Should be less GPU complaints 🙂
DLSS support added. I myself prefer to play without it since I have a FullHD monitor, but you can now enable it.
Made it so that item information in inventory appears on the side. It's more convenient that way

Fixes:
Fixed incorrect position of the sun on the global map after combat
Reduced rotation speed of units around themselves
